definition: Returns a geometric object representing the point set intersection of this geometric object with anotherGeometry.

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/intersection to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/intersection, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/intersection/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
